items.prompt: Why is equal vector length insufficient before taking a financial dot product?

options.text: Lengths never matter for dot products
options.why: The coordinates must have matching dimensions as well as meaning.

options.text: A dot product automatically sorts instruments
options.why: Unlabeled numeric coordinates do not carry that alignment guarantee.

options.text: Coordinate identity, order and units must match too
options.why: Correct arithmetic on misaligned meanings can still be wrong.
Real dot products allow negative coordinates.

items.explanation: The mathematical vector representation is only useful if coordinate semantics are aligned.
